title: terrdiag: Two-Layer Territorial Diagnostic Framework

creators.name: Coutinho, Álvaro Luz Alves
creators.affiliation: Universidade de São Paulo, Escola Superior de Agricultura Luiz de Queiroz (ESALQ/USP)

description:
terrdiag is a Python library implementing a two-layer territorial diagnostic framework for longitudinal public policy metrics.

  • Layer 1 builds entity-level (municipal) typologies via PCA and K-means on socio-environmental indicators, with bootstrap stability checks (ARI) and post-hoc independence tests.
  • Layer 2 applies global and local Moran's I (LISA) with distance-based spatial weights (Gaussian kernel, k-nearest neighbours, inverse distance) to point-level outcomes, including bandwidth sensitivity sweeps.
  • Overlay cross-tabulates both layers into diagnostic cells that signal territorial tensions between structural typology and outcome dynamics.

Every high-level call is logged and input files are hashed (SHA-256) to support reproducible runs. The package ships a reference data-preparation pipeline for Brazil's RenovaBio programme (terrdiag.case_studies.renovabio).

Status: beta (0.5.0b7). The public API may change before 1.0.

Funding. This study was financed in part by the Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior – Brasil (CAPES) – Finance Code 001, and by grant #2025/01530-0, São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP).
